help.title: About Product orders
help.overview: A product order is one customer checkout. Checkout writes the order. This page does not create one. Three statuses move on their own: the order, the payment, and the fulfillment.

sections.title: The three statuses
sections.body: Read them together. An order can be paid and still unfulfilled, or shipped and only partly refunded.
items: Order status runs pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded.
Payment status runs unpaid, authorized, paid, partially refunded, refunded, voided.
Fulfillment status runs unfulfilled, partially fulfilled, fulfilled, returned.

sections.title: What the row actions do
sections.body: Confirm, mark processing, ship, mark paid, cancel, and refund are separate. Each one is refused outside its state.
items: Confirm is only from pending. It acknowledges the order, which is the usual step for cash on delivery or a bank transfer, and tells the customer.
Mark processing is only from confirmed. It means the order is being prepared.

Ship is from confirmed or processing. It creates a fulfillment for the quantities still unfulfilled, takes those units out of stock, and sets the order status from its shipments. You can record a carrier, a tracking number, and a tracking link.

Mark paid records an offline payment (cash on delivery or bank transfer) and only while payment is unpaid and the order is not cancelled or refunded. A pending order is confirmed at the same time. Gift cards and downloads bought with the order are issued. Stock stays held until it ships.

Cancel is blocked once the order is shipped, delivered, cancelled, or refunded. A paid or partially refunded order must be refunded before it can be cancelled. Cancel releases stock still held and returns store credit applied with a gift card.
Refund is for a paid or partially refunded order. A full refund also returns that store credit, disables gift cards the order issued, expires its downloads, and releases stock still held.

sections.title: Where the rest of the work is
sections.body: This list is the order. The shipment and the return are their own pages.
items: Each shipment is a row under Fulfillments, with its own pending, shipped, delivered, or failed status.
A return, exchange, or refund request is a row under Return requests. Completing one can refund this order.
Deleting an order is a soft delete and it can be restored.
